subject: Malaysia M-510 pigment for PPC coating formulations
body:
The PLP range includes P-thane Finish 1200, a two-component polyurethane industrial finish.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS lists wall latex paints and zirconium/aluminium treatment; suitability for industrial resin coatings requires formulation assessment.

Could you route this to PPC's raw-material purchasing team so I can send the M-510 technical sheet?
